items.title: Swiss regulator FINMA approves country’s first spot bitcoin ETF for retail investors
items.summary: FINMA approved Switzerland's first retail bitcoin ETF, following earlier crypto ETP listings and a fund restricted to qualified investors.

items.title: FINMA approves Switzerland’s first Bitcoin ETF for retail investors
items.summary: The Swiss regulator cited a growing appetite for cryptocurrency investments and said that multiple fund providers have submitted Bitcoin ETF applications.

items.title: Mastercard launches stablecoin risk screening for banks and payment providers
items.summary: The new service combines payment data and blockchain analytics to help banks detect suspicious stablecoin transactions before settlement.

items.title: Mastercard unveils Stablecoin Security tool to screen payments for fraud and sanctions risks
items.summary: Mastercard unveiled Stablecoin Security, a risk screening service launching in North America before planned global availability in 2027.

items.title: Banks Hold a Lever Over Stablecoin Adoption, BIS Economists Say
items.summary: A Bank for International Settlements working paper found that stablecoin growth slows when U.S. banks raise deposit rates, with Circle’s USDC most sensitive.

items.title: France's parliament approves vote to hit stablecoin trades with 31% capital gains tax
items.summary: Amendment I-3898 removes tax deferral for MiCA-compliant stablecoins starting January 2027.

items.title: Market participants weigh in on SEC’s proposed crypto regulations
items.summary: The financial agency is scheduled to close public comments on its ‘Regulation Crypto Assets’ proposed in August.

items.title: Injective partners with BDACS to bring Korean won stablecoin to RWA ecosystem
items.summary: The move comes amid South Korea's regulatory developments to establish a framework for Korean won-denominated stablecoins.
